summary: A multi-role API supporting citizen and staff workflows. It handles user registration/login (including Telegram auth), role management, office/category data, report lifecycle (creation, review, assignment to staff/external users, start/finish/suspend/resume), and messaging notifications.

authentication_notes: /sessions/login and /sessions/telegram/verify are the only public auth endpoints. All other operations require authentication tokens obtained from these endpoints.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.

GET /categories is required before creating reports (POST /reports)
GET /offices and GET /offices/{id} provide office data; GET /offices/{id}/categories depends on a valid office id
GET /conversations is required before accessing or posting messages to specific conversations
PATCH /reports/{id}/assign_external depends on availability of staff via GET /sessions/available_staff

risks: Ambiguity in role assignment: PATCH /sessions/{id}/role vs PUT /sessions/{id}/roles may conflict if not clearly distinguished by client logic.
External maintainer operations (/reports/{id}/external/*) assume the external user is authenticated but do not specify how they obtain tokens.
Telegram verification endpoint does not require auth, which could allow unauthenticated users to bypass login if username/code validation is weak.
Report lifecycle states (start/finish/suspend/resume) are stateful; missing error handling for invalid state transitions is a risk.
Email verification flow relies on external email service; 410 Gone may indicate expired codes but lacks retry guidance.
